name: acqagent
description: Open-source Claude skills for federal acquisition — FAR research, clause checks, and compliance groundwork.

plugins.name: far-clause-checker
plugins.description: Validates a user's FAR 52.2xx clause list against the acquisition.gov (GSA) Smart Matrix during the Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO): existence, alternates, date currency, and Part 19 set-aside fit. Produces a standalone .docx compliance report. FAR only; HHSAR, DFARS, and other supplements are out of scope.

plugins.name: acquisition-policy-workflow
plugins.description: Source-grounded federal acquisition policy research across eCFR, Federal Register, Regulations.gov, and Acquisition.gov.

plugins.name: market-research-workflow
plugins.description: Staged FAR Part 10 market research with clear evidence, readiness, and decision boundaries.
